plugins.name: telegram
plugins.description: Telegram channel for Claude Code — messaging bridge with built-in access control. Manage pairing, allowlists, and policy via /telegram:access.

skills.name: access
skills.description: Manage Telegram channel access — approve pairings, edit allowlists, set DM/group policy. Use when the user asks to pair, approve someone, check who's allowed, or change policy for the Telegram channel.
skills.description_zh: 管理 Telegram 通道访问，包括批准配对、编辑允许名单及设置私聊／群组策略，支持查询谁有访问权和修改策略。

skills.name: configure
skills.description: Set up the Telegram channel — save the bot token and review access policy. Use when the user pastes a Telegram bot token, asks to configure Telegram, asks "how do I set this up" or "who can reach me," or wants to check channel status.
skills.description_zh: 设置 Telegram 通道，保存机器人令牌并审查访问策略，支持配置、可联系用户范围及通道状态检查。
